reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000918 (the melody read from 000918a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 21); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Louis J. F. Herold has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1839, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105).
